exercises.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive? [¿Cuál usa correctamente el subjuntivo?]
options: Es importante que tengamos tiempo. [It is important that we have time.]
Es importante que tenemos tiempo. [It is important that we have time.]
Es importante que tener tiempo. [It is important to have time.]

exercises.sentence: Es mejor que __ un equilibrio. [It is better for you to look for a balance.]
exercises.english: It is better for you to look for a balance.
It seems fundamental to me that a person finds fulfilment.

sentences: Primero, el trabajo es importante. [First, work is important.]
Después, el tiempo libre también importa. [Then free time also matters.]
Por eso, es importante que tengamos tiempo para nosotros. [So it is important that we have time for ourselves.]

exercises.question: Which word means «priority»? [¿Qué palabra significa «prioridad»?]
options: prioridad [priority]
satisfacción [satisfaction]
éxito [success]

exercises.sentence: Para mí, una gran __ es tener tiempo libre. [For me, a major priority is having free time.]

options: It is better for you to look for a balance.

options: It is important that we have time for ourselves.

exercises.sentence: Me parece fundamental que una persona encuentre satisfacción en su trabajo.
exercises.english: I think it is essential for a person to find satisfaction in their work.

options: Es importante que tengamos tiempo para nosotros. [It is important that we have time for ourselves.]

template.prompt: State an important priority using the subjunctive.
template.answer: Es importante que tengamos tiempo para nosotros.

template.prompt: Explain what matters most to you.
template.answer: Para mí, es fundamental que mi trabajo tenga sentido y que tenga tiempo libre.

template.prompt: Give an evaluation using es mejor que.
template.answer: Es mejor que una persona busque un equilibrio entre trabajo y vida personal.
